metadata.name: API Management AI Gateway
metadata.description: Deploys a standalone AI Gateway and its workspace-scoped model and tool configuration.
Workspace configuration and its nested resources.
Model provider configuration and catalog models.
Provider authentication with secure input references.
Supported inline model and workspace policies.
An alias route to a provider model.
MCP or OpenAPI tool server configuration.
Application Insights or OpenTelemetry exporter configuration.
API key metadata and optional secure input references.
Alias wire properties for the preview routes contract.
Provider kind selects its required configuration.
Tool server wire properties. Connector-backed servers are deliberately excluded.
Cost limit policy. Amounts are whole USD in this draft.
Provider configuration and nested catalog models.
Typed inline governance policies supported by this draft.
Route to a catalog model. Lower priority wins; weight is relative within a priority group.
Token limit policy with public counter dimensions.
MCP or URL-based OpenAPI upstream endpoint.
Default workspace configuration. Additional named workspaces require preview RP support verification before extending this type.
Optional. Specify the name of lock.
Optional. Specify the type of lock.
Optional. Specify the notes of the lock.
An AVM-aligned type for a lock.
Optional. Enables system assigned managed identity on the resource.
Optional. The resource ID(s) to assign to the resource. Required if a user assigned identity is used for encryption.
An AVM-aligned type for a managed identity configuration. To be used if both a system-assigned & user-assigned identities are supported by the resource provider.
Optional. The name (as GUID) of the role assignment. If not provided, a GUID will be generated.

Required. The role to assign. You can provide either the display name of the role definition, the role definition GUID, or its fully qualified ID in the following format: '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/roleDefinitions/c2f4ef07-c644-48eb-af81-4b1b4947fb11'.
Required. The principal ID of the principal (user/group/identity) to assign the role to.
Optional. The principal type of the assigned principal ID.
Optional. The description of the role assignment.

Optional. The conditions on the role assignment. This limits the resources it can be assigned to. e.g.: @Resource[Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers:ContainerName] StringEqualsIgnoreCase "foo_storage_container".
Optional. The Resource Id of the delegated managed identity resource.
An AVM-aligned type for a role assignment.
Required. The name of the AI Gateway. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
Optional. Azure region with AI Gateway preview availability.
Optional. The only SKU accepted by the preview resource provider.
Optional. Managed identities assigned to the gateway.
Optional. Role assignments scoped to the gateway, not to upstream Foundry accounts.
Optional. Resource lock applied after child configuration is deployed.
Optional. Enable AVM module usage telemetry. This is independent of runtime telemetry exporters.
Optional. Virtual network configuration. Preview region and subnet requirements apply.
Optional. Gateway-level API keys. Key values are generated by the service unless secret references are supplied.
Optional. Workspace configuration. The service provisions default automatically; omit policies to reference it without a PUT.
Optional. Secret values indexed by the secret names used in child configurations. Supply through secure parameters or Key Vault; never commit values.

variables.userAssignedIdentities: [reduce(map(coalesce(tryGet(parameters('managedIdentities'), 'userAssignedResourceIds'), createArray()), lambda('id', createObject(format('{0}', lambdaVariables('id')), createObject()))), createObject(), lambda('current', 'next', union(lambdaVariables('current'), lambdaVariables('next'))))]

properties.notes: [coalesce(tryGet(parameters('lock'), 'notes'), if(equals(tryGet(parameters('lock'), 'kind'), 'CanNotDelete'), 'Cannot delete resource or child resources.', 'Cannot delete or modify the resource or child resources.'))]

metadata.name: AI Gateway API Key
metadata.description: Configures a gateway-level API key without returning its secret values.
API key metadata and optional secure input references.
Optional. Secure values for explicit primary and secondary key references.

apiKey.name: [format('{0}/{1}', parameters('aiGatewayName'), parameters('name'))]
apiKey.properties: [union(createObject('displayName', tryGet(parameters('properties'), 'displayName'), 'state', tryGet(parameters('properties'), 'state'), 'expirationDate', tryGet(parameters('properties'), 'expirationDate')), if(equals(tryGet(parameters('properties'), 'primaryKeySecretName'), null()), createObject(), createObject('primaryKey', parameters('secrets')[parameters('properties').primaryKeySecretName])), if(equals(tryGet(parameters('properties'), 'secondaryKeySecretName'), null()), createObject(), createObject('secondaryKey', parameters('secrets')[parameters('properties').secondaryKeySecretName])))]

metadata.description: The API key resource ID, not the key value.
